description: HP-51 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) serving the Shimla Rural jurisdiction in Himachal Pradesh. It operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office and handles vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the rural areas surrounding the capital city.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM) Shimla Rural, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
